recognize_zh: 高倍率骨髓免疫染色：成片的中型細胞呈強烈細胞膜兼細胞質陽性，細胞核圓至卵圓、細胞質量中等，旁邊一群陰性的造血細胞圍繞在脂肪空泡旁；陽性細胞密集取代骨髓，符合 B 細胞標記標出的毛細胞白血病變異型浸潤。
features: Sheets of intermediate-sized cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic brown staining
Round to oval, centrally placed pale nuclei with moderate cytoplasm
Crisp cell borders creating a mosaic/fried-egg outline
Small cluster of negative hematopoietic cells adjacent to a fat space
Near-complete replacement of the field by positive cells
describe_en: High-power immunohistochemical stain of bone marrow shows sheets of intermediate-sized cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, replacing most of the field. The positive cells have round to oval nuclei, moderate amounts of cytoplasm and crisp borders, while a small cluster of negative residual hematopoietic cells lies next to a fat space. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern is most consistent with a B-cell marker such as CD20. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow infiltration by a B-cell neoplasm, in context hairy cell leukemia variant.

ddx.vs: Morphology and CD20 are shared; annexin A1, CD25, CD123 and BRAF V600E positivity define classic HCL.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL has intrasinusoidal marrow involvement, is usually CD103-negative, and lacks the prominent nucleoli of HCL-v.
MCL cells are CD5+, cyclin D1 strongly nuclear+ and SOX11+.

stain: IHC: B-cell marker, presumed CD20 (not labeled)
